outcome: Actual preparation and required checks establish readiness for this repository and a second project.
acceptance: production environment preparation runs configured commands through a real local command executor when no test runner is supplied
the same versioned profile prepares two project workspaces and records profile version, workspace identity, command status, exit code, and log artifacts
missing executors, denied tools, missing commands, or failed required checks remain visible blockers
canStartImplementation reads the latest recorded prepare result and never manufactures passing checks
Generator is blocked when the latest project environment is not ready even if a caller passes environmentReady true
a repaired workspace becomes ready after a later prepare with passing required checks
optional lint and hygiene checks remain blocked when they are unavailable or probe-blocked
command output persisted for environment evidence is redacted for secret environment values
inScope: Web/API prepare inputs for project-scoped readiness
assumptions: The current dsh host exposes local process execution to plugins through the Node host process for this first slice.
Tests may inject deterministic runners, but the production default must not be a test-only runner.
